Contact.title: Let's talk
Contact.description: Write about a role, a project or a technical question. The message is saved before any attempt to send it — if the email fails, it is resent on its own.
Contact.directText: The form stores the message before trying to notify me, so it doesn't get lost. But if you'd rather take the short route, the two addresses below reach me just the same.
Contact.name: Name
Contact.subject: Subject
Contact.sentText: It's already saved. I'll reply to the address you left.
Contact.genericFailure: I couldn't send your message right now. Try again in a moment, or write directly to the email address next to the form.
Contact.turnstileRefused: The anti-bot check rejected this attempt. Try sending again.
Contact.turnstileMissing: The anti-bot check didn't load — usually a content blocker or the network. Wait a moment and try again; if it keeps happening, write directly to the email address next to the form.
Contact.rateLimited: You've already sent a few messages today. {espera}
Contact.rejectedByServer: Your message didn't pass the server's validation. Write directly to the email address next to the form — it will reach me just the same.
